# GitHub Automation Rules

## Standard

- `GH-001` GitHub automation MUST be stored under `.github/`.
- `GH-002` Workflow definitions MUST be stored under `.github/workflows/`.
- `GH-003` Repository-local composite actions MUST be stored under `.github/actions/`.
- `GH-004` Automation SHOULD use simple, explicit structures.
- `GH-005` Names MUST be semantic and consistent.

## Preferences

- `GH-P001` Repository-specific preferences MAY extend rules defined in child directories.
